prowler_aws.title: Avoid the use of the root account
prowler_aws.description: Root account has full administrative privileges and was recently logged into without MFA.
prowler_aws.remediation: Lock root access keys, enforce hardware MFA, and delegate daily admin tasks to IAM roles.

prowler_aws.title: Ensure S3 Bucket Policy restricts public read/write access
prowler_aws.description: S3 bucket is publicly accessible over the internet allowing unauthenticated data theft.
prowler_aws.remediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access at bucket and account level, update bucket policy.

prowler_aws.title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
prowler_aws.description: Multi-region logging is disabled in ap-south-1 (Mumbai).
prowler_aws.remediation: Configure CloudTrail multi-region trail logging to send logs to centralized S3 bucket.

kube_bench_k8s.title: Ensure anonymous requests are rejected by API server
kube_bench_k8s.description: Kubernetes API server allows unauthenticated anonymous requests (--anonymous-auth=true).

kube_bench_k8s.title: Minimize privileged containers in cluster
kube_bench_k8s.description: Container runs with securityContext.privileged=true allowing container escape.
kube_bench_k8s.remediation: Drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN capabilities and disable privileged mode in PodSpec.
